title: Multimarket Contact and Mutual Forbearance in Audit Markets

scopes.description: Full supplied author workflow: main 2-digit SIC construction and sample selection, the separate FF48 sensitivity branch, and the Table 9 switcher-choice preparation and analysis branch.

requirements.description: The main branch imports the author-named AuditAnalytics source and consumes company_fkey, fiscal_year, audit_fees, auditor_fkey, sic_code_fkey, bus_state, and bus_county. The datasheet describes Audit Analytics audit-fee data for 2004–2015; the exact integrated file, key types, covered rows, and lead/history compatibility are unverified.

routes.description: Frozen catalog candidate AUDIT.FEED03_AUDIT_FEES. It is a fee-feed candidate only; discovery does not establish the complete author input, integrated SIC/state/county fields, identifier mapping, format, history, or read access.

The datasheet names Audit Analytics through WRDS for 2004–2015; the page describes subscriber access. Subscription, exact feed, integrated fields, history, and compatible delivery to this user remain unverified.
Vendor pricing page says data feeds are sold separately; it does not establish this user's access, the required feed, field integration, historical coverage, or a confirmed access barrier.

requirements.description: The main merged panel requires the Compustat source imported as compustat.txt. The code constructs year_aa from datadate/fyear, and the Access SQL explicitly joins year_aa to fiscal_year and Compustatdata.cik to AAData.company_fkey. The retrieval comment says year_aa/gvkey; compatibility of the actual CIK/company_fkey field types and populations remains unverified, and the comment discrepancy is not evidence of a required conversion. The datasheet states 2004–2015.

routes.description: Frozen catalog candidate COMP.FUNDA. Catalog discovery identifies the annual file and selected matching fields, but does not establish author-source compatibility, CIK/company_fkey type and population compatibility for the documented SQL, 2004–2015 coverage, or read access; the gvkey comment does not specify a conversion.

The datasheet names Compustat through WRDS for 2004–2015, and the official page describes subscriber access. Subscription, delivered file, CIK/company_fkey compatibility, year_aa construction, and author-period coverage remain unverified; the gvkey reference is a separate comment discrepancy.

requirements.description: The separate FF48 construction driver reads auditanalytics20112019_start.dta, for which this release provides no producer or prepared file. The filename suggests a period but does not verify it; required columns include the fields used for market construction, including auditor_fkey, fiscal_year, msa_number, ff48, and audit_fees.

The main preparation branch reads Mwsox.txt for count_weak and matchfy_sumfees_fy and manually deduplicates/matches it by company_fkey and fiscal year. This is distinct from materialweakness.txt, and no source file or compatible route is supplied.

The main preparation branch reads restatements.txt with file_date, fiscal_ye, matchfy_sumfees_fy, and company_fkey fields to create rest_filing for a manual Access match. The required source population and file are not supplied.

The main preparation branch reads segments.txt and uses datadate, gvkey, cik, stype, sid, and snms to construct year and sumsegments before an Excel deduplication and Access match. The exact client-key mapping and compatible source file are unresolved.

The main preparation branch separately reads materialweakness.txt and uses material_weakness, matchfy_sumfees_fy, and company_fkey to construct mw. It is a distinct input from Mwsox.txt and no compatible source file is supplied.

The main manual Access join requires the goingconcern table with fiscal_year_of_op, company_fkey, and going_concern; the code later uses going_concern to form gc. This table has no supplied producer or compatible file.

issues.description: The included workflow has required manual Excel deduplication and Microsoft Access joins across Stata stages. Exact schemas, source ownership, keys/cardinality, and completed handoff files are not supplied; the Table 9 selector and Table10.dat assembly are separately unresolved.

The FF48 branch has separate imported and generated filenames, including a consumer name that does not match its supplied producer. Compatibility and the branch's actual output contract are unresolved.
Table 9 initializes switchsample to zero and leaves the switcher marking as a commented placeholder. Its manual Excel/Access preparation and Table10.dat field contract are unspecified.
The active KLAD lines use res_begin_date/res_end_date without a named producer and include incomplete statements. Their source rows and intended expressions are unknown.
The main producer creates mm_rank2 through mm_rank64, while later construction loops through mm_rank70. The intended upper bound and definitions for mm_rank65–70 are not supplied.

The Access SQL explicitly joins year_aa to AAData.fiscal_year and Compustatdata.cik to AAData.company_fkey. The retrieval comment instead names year_aa/gvkey. The SQL defines the current join; imported CIK/company_fkey types and populations remain unverified, and the comment mismatch does not establish a required identifier conversion.

The main code creates adjacent-year lead/change fields before filtering to 2004–2015; next-row values may be missing at the last observed year, and the main complete-case list does not drop those lead fields. create feedataset.do marks each company's earliest observed row firstyear=1 and checks up to five prior rows. Actual input coverage and author boundary treatment remain relevant to output fidelity, but the source does not establish that extra 2003 or 2016 rows are mandatory before any run.
The FF48 selection drops fiscal_year below 2015 and retains 2015 onward, while the datasheet describes source coverage through 2015. Preserve the authored filter pending clarification.
Table 9 uses save using at line 133, which does not match Stata 18 save syntax. A filename-only edit preserves the named output.
create feedataset.do renames sumsegments to busseg at line 44 and repeats that rename at line 92 without a supplied recreation of sumsegments in between.
All eight launch drivers contain the literal cd placeholder. A common relative run root is a routine configuration choice; scripts, helpers, inputs, and intermediates must resolve from that root.

evidence.description: The main producer creates mm_rank2 through mm_rank64.
evidence.quote:
sort fiscal_year msa_number sic2digit auditor_fkey
*rank auditors
** add random noise term (smaller than 1) to total audit fees per auditor to break ties 
gen double x=sumfees_auditor+uniform()
egen rankfirm=rank(-x), by(msa_number sic2digit fiscal_year)
drop x
sort fiscal_year msa_number sic2digit rankfirm

* generate matrix/ maximum i = maximum rankfirm
local i=2
while `i'<=64 {
quietly{
gen mm_rank`i'=.
noisily di " " `i'
local i=`i'+1
}
}
